properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.ui.security-chain-enabled
properties.description: Whether the shell contributes its own security filter chain. It permits the exact paths the active views declared, never a /ui/** pattern, so a gateway route under /ui does not inherit the UI permissions. Turn it off to secure those paths from the application instead.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.ui.security.mode
properties.description: How the chain treats the paths the console serves: PERMIT_ALL leaves them open behind whatever the application authenticates elsewhere, AUTHENTICATED puts the login page of the console in front of them.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.ui.security.write-mode
properties.description: How the chain treats the paths a plugin declared as changing the gateway, such as the route management API: AUTO asks for a principal as soon as there is something to authenticate against and leaves them open with a warning otherwise, AUTHENTICATED always asks for one, PERMIT_ALL treats them as any other path and follows the mode.
